meta.note: All layers of the CNMH report map on the paramilitary Bloque Calima, read in full with each feature tagged by its source_layer (presence and influence zones and fronts by period, plus the report's other layers such as massacres, bases and context maps); the server generalised polygons at 0.0005 degrees (about 55 m) when read; one source feature sits far outside Colombia (longitude -152) and is kept as published.
